Actor Jr NTR to Undergo Shoulder Surgery in Hyderabad

Actor Jr NTR is scheduled to undergo shoulder surgery in Hyderabad on Tuesday. Following the procedure, his team has requested privacy from fans and media. The shooting for his upcoming film, tentatively titled 'Dragon', has been temporarily paused due to the surgery.
